stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 11 hours and pipe B can fill it in 14 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/11$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/14$. Combined rate $= 1/11 + 1/14 = 0.1623$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/11+1/14} = 6.16$ hours.
